sources.doctors.sessionStart: [assumption] Evening private chamber 18:00-21:00; see sensitivity sweep.
sources.doctors.bookedCount: [assumption] Fully booked 3-hour session at 10-minute slots (= 18 slots, 16 booked).
sources.doctors.startLateMeanMin: [assumption] No published data for Bangladesh chambers; sensitivity sweep.
sources.visits.newMedianMin: [derived] Das et al. 2021, Healthcare 9(9):1164, doi:10.3390/healthcare9091164: mean 9.10 min, SD 4.44 (n=763, six district/upazila hospitals, Bangladesh). Log-normal median = mean / sqrt(1+CV^2) = 8.2.
sources.visits.followUpMedianMin: [assumption] Das et al. 2021 report follow-up visits are longer (beta=0.13) without a size; same as new visits here.
sources.patients.latenessMeanMin: [derived] Cerruti et al. 2023, BMC Health Serv Res 23:1385, doi:10.1186/s12913-023-10379-w: 84.4% check in early, mostly within 15 min of the slot (n=410,808 visits, Milan). Normal with P(early)=0.844 and most mass in +-15 min gives mean -10, SD 10.
sources.patients.noShowP: [cited] Dantas et al. 2018, Health Policy 122(4):412-421, doi:10.1016/j.healthpol.2018.02.002: average no-show rate about 23% (range by continent 13.2%-43.0%). Sensitivity 10%-35%.
sources.patients.walkInPerHour: [assumption] No Bangladesh data; reported walk-in shares range from <=20% (Malaysia) to 72% (Taiwan). Sensitivity sweep.
sources.lab.lines.blood.typicalMin: [cited] Toomukuntla et al. 2023, Cureus 15(8):e43323, doi:10.7759/cureus.43323: registration 1.1 min + phlebotomy 2.2 min (n=1,200, India).
sources.lab.lines.blood.cv: [derived] Toomukuntla et al. 2023 report '2SD' 0.75 (registration) and 0.81 (draw); combined SD about 0.55 / 3.3 = 0.17, rounded up to 0.2.
sources.lab.lines.blood.turnaroundMin: [derived] Lockhat et al. 2021 (Afr J Lab Med 10(1):1318, doi:10.4102/ajlm.v10i1.1318): outpatient FBC collection-to-registration median 96 min + intra-lab median 55 min = about 150 min. Bangladesh aggregators list 2-24 h.
sources.lab.lines.blood.turnaroundCv: [derived] Same source: IQRs 73-133 and 40-81 min give a log-normal spread of about 0.5.
sources.lab.lines.blood.mustFirst: [assumption] Fasting blood tests are drawn before other tests.
sources.lab.lines.ecg.typicalMin: [assumption] 12-lead resting ECG incl. preparation; no time-motion study found.
sources.lab.lines.ecg.turnaroundMin: [assumption] ECG printout is available at once.
sources.lab.lines.xray.typicalMin: [assumption] Two-view chest radiograph takes a few minutes of technologist time (Reiner et al. 2005, Radiology 236(2):413-419, doi:10.1148/radiol.2362040671); exact figure not verified.
sources.lab.orderP: [assumption] Experiment scenario: half of consultations order tests.
sources.lab.testsPerOrder: [assumption] Experiment scenario: every lab patient has 2-4 tests, so routing has a choice to make.
sources.lab.nowP: [assumption] Share of patients who go to the lab right after the consultation.
sources.lab.outsidePerHour: [assumption] Patients coming only for tests; sensitivity sweep.
sources.returns.travelBufferMin: [assumption] Walk back from the lab to the chamber.
sources.staff.awayWhenCalledP: [assumption] Share of called patients who are not at the door; no published value; sensitivity sweep.
sources.staff.awayMedianMin: [assumption] Minutes until a skipped patient is back (log-normal, CV awayCv).
sources.staff.comesBackP: [assumption] Share of skipped patients who come back.
sources.staff.skipLateP: [assumption] How often staff follow the app suggestion to skip a late booked patient.
sources.staff.priorityP: [assumption] Share of patients staff mark as priority (elderly, very ill).
sources.staff.undoCallP: [assumption] Mis-taps on Call next that are undone.
